title: Quadratics
description: Expanding, factorising and solving quadratics, sketching their graphs, and where a line meets a curve.
objectives: Recognise the shape of a quadratic graph
Expand the product of two brackets
Solve a quadratic equation by factorising
Solve a line and a curve simultaneously, using the discriminant to count the points of intersection
Sketch a quadratic graph from its roots, y-intercept and turning point, completing the square
